newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: HORSE RACING-Powers cut Coome Hill's price for Cheltenham Cup.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-Powers cut Coome Hill's price for Cheltenham Cup.

text.p: Irish bookmaker firm Paddy Powers said on Thursday it had cut the odds against Coome Hill landing the 1997 Cheltenham Gold Cup by one point to 7-1.
Powers said it had cut its price on Coome Hill landing the Cheltenham Gold Cup after the Walter Dennis-trained gelding had won Thursday's Jim Ford Challenge Cup Chase at Wincanton.
The favourite for the Cheltenham feature race, Ireland's Imperial Call, has eased out half-a-point in the betting to 4-1, Powers said.
Power quoted Ireland's Doran's Pride as second-favourite at 5-1 while Danoli is quoted at 6-1.
